title: Membrane-free osmotic power generators with high-performance energy conversion
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01945E, Paper
Shengyang Zhou, Dehua Huang, Guangpeng Ma, Xuanyi Tong, Yang Liu, Linsen Yang, Tianchi Liu, Xiang-Yu Kong, Liping Wen
Membrane-free osmotic power generators based on polyelectrolyte-based aqueous two-phase systems are proposed to achieve record power densities at a macroscopical scale.
